verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's official help site says its tutorials take users step-by-step through installing Ubuntu Desktop and exploring the user interface. The documentation index lists 'Try Ubuntu Desktop', 'Create a bootable USB stick' and 'Install Ubuntu Desktop', plus switcher-specific install guidance for BitLocker and Intel RST and a beginner command-line tutorial. Missing for 10: detail on the content of the desktop-interface tutorial (only one summary line), and independent or hands-on corroboration that these tutorials work well for switchers.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can follow guided tutorials to install the OS and learn the desktop interface
